##### Project general facts

Park Beach Residence is a luxury residential development in Ras Al Khaimah, located in a resort setting and designed around modern comfort and coastal living. The development offers a selection of apartments with panoramic views of the sea and white sandy beaches, creating a tranquil residential environment. Its contemporary design combines functionality, comfort, and a sophisticated atmosphere suited to both everyday living and relaxation.

The development offers a range of amenities and features designed to enhance residents’ comfort and leisure experience. The resort setting provides access to the coastal environment, while the development’s thoughtful design focuses on creating a comfortable and relaxing atmosphere. Panoramic views of the sea and surrounding beaches further enhance the residential experience and connection with the waterfront.

The apartments feature full modern finishing using high-quality materials and are equipped with smart home systems. Each residence includes a fully equipped kitchen, while the apartments are delivered unfurnished, allowing residents to personalize their interiors according to their preferences. The combination of contemporary finishes, smart technology, and coastal views creates a refined residential environment.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Marjan Island is a prominent man-made archipelago in Ras Al Khaimah, located along the Arabian Gulf coastline. Comprising four coral-shaped islands connected by a central boulevard, the destination is known for its beaches, luxury resorts, and upscale residential developments. Its waterfront setting provides residents and visitors with panoramic views of the Arabian Gulf and a distinctive coastal environment.

The island features approximately 5.4 kilometres of white sandy beaches, offering opportunities for swimming, sunbathing, and water sports such as jet skiing and paddleboarding. Al Marjan Island is also home to a collection of luxury hotels and resorts with a variety of amenities, including private beaches, swimming pools, spas, and dining venues. Its retail and dining scene includes high-end shops, boutiques, and waterfront restaurants.

Al Marjan Island also offers a variety of entertainment and recreational activities throughout the year, including concerts, fireworks displays, and cultural events. Outdoor fitness areas and jogging tracks support an active lifestyle, while the island’s combination of leisure, hospitality, dining, and waterfront facilities creates a diverse environment for both residents and visitors.
